# Saturn integration audit — repo fact-sheet index

Consolidated row-per-integration view of the six fact-sheets in this directory. Each row is sourced from the cited fact-sheet; follow that file for code-path citations and code excerpts.

| Integration | Repo URL | Install | Default endpoint | Last release | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open WebUI | https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui | `pip install open-webui && open-webui serve` (or `ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main` Docker image) | `https://api.openai.com/v1` (single); list semicolon-separated via `OPENAI_API_BASE_URLS` | v0.9.2, 2026-04-24 | Env vars `OPENAI_API_BASE_URL{,S}` and `OPENAI_API_KEY{,S}` are seeds only — values are persisted to the DB `config` table (`PersistentConfig`) on first boot. Live override is via the `/openai/urls/update` admin endpoint, or set `ENABLE_PERSISTENT_CONFIG=False`. Source: [owui.md](owui.md). |
| opencode | https://github.com/sst/opencode | `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install \| bash` / `npm i -g opencode-ai@latest` / `brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode` | per-provider `model.api.url` from models.dev catalog (no global default) | v1.14.40, 2026-05-07 | JSON-only override at `provider.<id>.options.baseURL` in `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` (override dir via `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`). No `OPENAI_API_BASE`-style env fallback; `${ENV_VAR}` substitution inside the `baseURL` string is supported, so a pre-seeded `${SATURN_URL}` placeholder is the only env-driven path. Source: [opencode.md](opencode.md). |
| Aider | https://github.com/Aider-AI/aider | `pip install aider-install && aider-install` (PyPI: `aider-chat`) | inherits LiteLLM defaults (no built-in default; falls through to provider's own) | v0.86.0, 2025-08-09 (main: 0.86.3.dev) | All three sources — `--openai-api-base` flag, `OPENAI_API_BASE` env, `.aider.conf.yml` key `openai-api-base` (CWD → git root → `$HOME`) — are normalised into the `OPENAI_API_BASE` env var at startup (`aider/main.py:620`). Companion `OPENAI_API_KEY` required (dummy value works for unauth Saturn). Trivial integration. Source: [aider.md](aider.md). |
| Jan | https://github.com/menloresearch/jan | Prebuilt binaries from https://jan.ai; from source `make` (Tauri + Yarn toolchain) | `https://api.openai.com/v1` per default OpenAI provider entry; fallback in chat client is `http://localhost:1337/v1` | v0.7.9, 2026-03-23 | No file-drop config path. Remote engines persist only in browser `localStorage` key `model-provider` (zustand `persist`); Rust mirror in `src-tauri/.../state.rs` is in-memory and re-registered each launch. Saturn injection requires either WebView-context localStorage write or a Tauri command/extension calling `register_provider_config`. LAN base URLs (`localhost`/`127.0.0.1`) automatically receive an `Origin: tauri://localhost` header. Source: [jan.md](jan.md). |
| mlx-omni-server | https://github.com/madroidmaq/mlx-omni-server | `pip install mlx-omni-server` then `mlx-omni-server` | binds `0.0.0.0:10240`; serves `/v1/{chat/completions,models,embeddings,audio/*,images/generations}` and `/anthropic/v1/*` | v0.5.2 (`pyproject.toml`); HEAD `0d3814d`, 2026-03-10; no git tags | Backend candidate (server, not client). Apple-Silicon MLX inference. Override bind via `--host`/`--port` (`src/mlx_omni_server/main.py:24-59`). **No `/v1/health` endpoint** — Saturn's 20s health poller will require a fallback (probe `/v1/models`) or an upstream patch adding `@app.get("/v1/health")`. Source: [mlx_omni.md](mlx_omni.md). |
| NousResearch (Hermes) | https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent (closest candidate) | `curl … install.sh \| bash` or `pip install -e .` (Python ≥3.11) | n/a — no OpenAI-compat surface | tag `v2026.4.30` (2026-04-30); pyproject `0.12.0`; HEAD `3cdbf33`, 2026-05-06 | **Negative finding.** No NousResearch repo ships an OpenAI-compatible inference server. `Hermes-Function-Calling` = CLI scripts only; `atropos` = RL training (consumes external server); `hermes-agent` = FastAPI but only `/api/*` UI routes — it is a *client* of OpenAI-compat providers, not a backend. Recommendation: drop as a Saturn backend candidate; serve Nous model weights via vLLM / llama.cpp / ollama / SGLang and advertise that instead. Source: [hermes.md](hermes.md). |

## Audit summary at a glance

- **Env-var driven (easy):** Aider, Open WebUI (first-boot only).
- **JSON-config driven (medium):** opencode (file mutation required), Open WebUI (admin endpoint after first boot).
- **No external config path (hard):** Jan (Tauri/localStorage; needs extension or WebView injection).
- **New backend viable:** mlx-omni-server (caveat: missing `/v1/health`).
- **New backend rejected:** NousResearch / Hermes (no server in the org).
